name: smwsprites-clawgrip
title: Clawgrip
description:
Clawgrip from SMB2.

Has numerous capabilities as far as customization goes; how fast it moves or throws rocks, how many times it goes back and forth or how many rocks it throws, as well as the ability for it to have multiple phases.

The code is loosely based on the SMB2 code itself but then heavily adapted, so the default pattern of the thrown rocks is almost identical and as such the same arena layout can be utilized.

Released as part of C3 2022.

Release History:
-- 7/10/2022 (v1.0) - Initial release.
